The $30.02 amount sits below the card's prior median of $49.97 (prior maximum $343.94 over the card's 46 prior transactions), so on amount alone this charge is not unusual for the card.

ring_profile found no ring_id and an empty, non-strong device on this card, and shared_origin_scan found no region_cluster_30d fan-out, so there is no shared-origin (R6) evidence tying this denial to other cards.
